description: A file-scope initializer runs in its place in the body: written after the body-top statement `n = 5`, `const k = n` gives k = 5 (S481 P2).
rationale: §7.6 rule (b) S481: a file-scope initializer written in the <program> body runs in its place in that sequence — after the body-top statements written before it. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S481-body-run-order — "The program body runs once, top to bottom, in source order, and that sequence is the module initialization. Every file-scope initializer runs whether or not anything reads it, so the S480 tool ruling extends to web programs. A display of a `free` value reads it where it stands." (owner: "yes, adopt your rec on P1–P3") Gap g-spec-file-scope-init-vs-body-top-write-s481.
